meta.title: Tikpal Room — High-fidelity sound that adapts to the moment
meta.description: Tikpal Room is an integrated amplifier, speaker and digital music system with ambient intelligence — one instrument for listening, unwinding and focus.

closingLine: Intelligence that moves with life. Hear it in every room.

hero.headline: High-fidelity sound that adapts to the moment.
hero.subtitle: Tikpal Room is a high-fidelity sound system with ambient intelligence — it senses your state, and shapes the music and atmosphere of your space.
hero.roadNote: We are building Tikpal Room piece by piece—starting with speakers, then amplification and streaming, before bringing the complete system into one enclosure.
hero.statusLine: Speakers first · Amplification and streaming next · All-in-one as the destination
